correctness.rationale: For each \(d\ge3\) the two affine types of four-row sets are exhaustive, with P=N(N-1)(N-2)/24 and I=P(N-4). Rank of any projected triple of cube vertices is three; among 70 projected quadruples there are 56 determinants of absolute value 8, two of 16 and 12 singular rank-three cases. For plane rows, all four projected types are mutually orthogonal. Including m=N/4 or N/8 extension multiplicities gives determinant totals. Occupancy inclusion-exclusion yields four factored rank polynomials; symbolic expansion of the formulas was checked identically. Independent direct integer checks on all 4,900 and 3,312,400 minors at d=3,4 reproduce rank and determinant frequencies; Cauchy--Binet gives an orthogonal consistency identity. No computation is extrapolated to infinite d: the affine-type proof handles all d.

value.rationale: The 4th compound of binary Walsh Fourier transforms is a natural finite interpolation, erasure conditioning and Hadamard-design invariant. A complete uniform all-d classification separates real-rank degeneracy from determinant magnitude, identifies every optimal 4-by-4 Hadamard selection, and gives dimension-free exact incidence polynomials. It contributes structural information not contained in mere existence/max-determinant or time-frequency support-cardinality bounds.
